one_star_reviews.text: I'm giving one star because I have to, and because the drivers are completely innocent and all incredibly friendly. But the service is worse than bad. I'm doing rehabilitation at La Esperanza and I have to come every day. Well, for the outbound trip, out of five days, they only came to pick me up once. Instead of 7:30, they came at 8:30, so I arrived an hour late. But the worst part is the return trip. I never know what time I'll get home because out of five days, it only arrived at the scheduled time once. I'd always heard that you have to be patient with ambulances, but day after day, it's a disaster. On top of that, after picking me up an hour late, they take me on a different route, taking advantage of the situation to transport other passengers. On one hand, I don't see anything wrong with that, but in my case, since I'm recently operated on and suffer so much during transfers, it's a disaster.

Today, September 28th, at 11:00 AM, an ambulance picked me up from Domingo in Santa Coloma de Gramenet to take me to Teknon Hospital. The driver circled my address twice before I stood up and signaled him. I was feeling dizzy on a bench and had to cross the road by myself. They told me to sit down and fasten my seatbelt. I called them because I was having arrhythmias, but they didn't even check my blood pressure. After a few seconds, I asked them to turn on the air conditioning or open my window. The air conditioning in the back wasn't working, so they opened my window. The ambulance started driving around the streets, and I told him to turn left because the garbage truck was going straight down that street. They were enjoying the fresh air and eating chips while I was dying of heat and exhaustion. This is the first time I've encountered two paramedics who behaved in such a rude and unprofessional manner. They clearly had little desire to work. In contrast, others are incredibly kind. Unfortunately, lately I've had to ask Adeslas for a lot of help. Ambulances, but I've never encountered such a situation. I'll talk to Adeslas; why can't these two disgraceful individuals tarnish a company's reputation? The owner should kick them out.

A terrible experience for my mother, a stroke patient in her second month of rehabilitation. Theoretically, the first year is crucial for stroke treatment, but I've noticed that in the second month, the ambulance service has been arriving 1-2 hours late for weeks. We call, and the only response we receive is that they don't have ambulances available and we just have to wait. This leaves my parents with language difficulties and my mother vulnerable and incapacitated in several ways due to the stroke, alone, waiting to see how she misses out on rehabilitation because the scheduled appointments have long since passed.

My mother bought a gold earring about a year ago for around €100-110. At the time of purchase, she was told it had a 3-year warranty. Recently, the clasp broke, and she went to the store to have it repaired.

Three weeks after taking the earring in, they told her the repair wasn't covered by the warranty because they considered it damage due to misuse and that she would have to pay around €40 to fix it. We find it outrageous that they charged almost half the original price. We understand that the warranty may have conditions, but we believe they should have clearly explained from the beginning that the 3-year warranty only covered manufacturing defects. I emphasize this because they didn't specify what was covered by the warranty.

Furthermore, my mother says the service she received from the employee was very unpleasant. It's a shame, because after spending over €100 on a piece of jewelry, we expected much better service and a better solution.

one_star_reviews.text:
The house is very beautiful and the surroundings are pleasant, but our experience was not very good, especially because of the treatment received by the owner.
Upon arrival, she made a comment about our age that made us feel judged. In addition, we had problems with the hot water and the owner and the technicians were in the house until almost 10:00 pm, which greatly limited our privacy.
We also found several aspects that could be improved, such as the cleaning of the pool, the lawn, the volleyball net and some elements of the house.
On the last day, despite having told us that we could stay until 6:00 pm, the owner came in before this time and began to inspect the house, reprimanding us for issues related to recycling. Later, we were informed that part of the deposit will be deducted for this reason and for a damage that we did not cause.
It's a shame, because the house has a lot of potential, but we consider that the management of the problems and the treatment received made the experience much worse.

The house is very beautiful, it is in a pleasant environment and, in general, the space has a lot of potential. Unfortunately, our experience was greatly affected by both the inconveniences of the house and, above all, by the treatment received from the owner.

Upon arrival, after seeing that we were a group of people between 28 and 32 years old, the owner said to us: “Wow, they have never sent me such young people before”. A comment that made us feel a little judged before we even started our stay.

We arrived at 5:00 pm and the hot water was not working properly. The owner and the people who came to fix it did not leave until approximately 10:00 pm, so for a good part of Friday we did not have the privacy you expect when renting an entire house. In addition, even after we left, some showers still had no hot water.

We also found other aspects that could be improved: there was only one small towel per person, the pool was not in good cleaning conditions, there was a plug in one room that did not work properly, the lawn was quite neglected and the volleyball net was in poor condition.

On the last day we asked if we could stay a little later and we were told that there would be no problem and that we could stay until 6:00 pm. However, at 5:45 pm the owner entered the house with her car and, without asking us how our stay had been or greeting us, she began to inspect the house and later spoke to us in a raised tone, reprimanding us, among other things, for not recycling properly.

We had indeed separated the garbage and, to avoid further conflicts, we even ended up taking it with us to our destination.

Later, we were informed that part of the deposit would be deducted for an alleged poor recycling and for a problem with a lamp holder that we did not break or manipulate. We find it particularly unfair that we are held responsible for this damage without having been the cause.

It is a shame, because the house is beautiful and the surroundings are very pleasant. Precisely for this reason we expected a much better experience. We believe that the treatment received and the way in which the different inconveniences were managed made a stay that could have been very good end up leaving us with a very negative feeling.

We hope that these issues will serve to improve the experience of future guests.

The house has many options but, the pool was dirty, the lawn poorly mowed and the volleyball net in poor condition.
The owner made the stay not as pleasant as it could have been, we arrived and there was no hot water and ended up leaving after 10pm, taking away the privacy that is required for a weekend like this. When she came to check us out, she came in a very bad mood and in a hurry when she had told us we would have more time. Looking for anything to avoid having to return the deposit, she found a broken glass in a light that, most likely, was not us, and she did not return 110€ to us. Honestly, a shame.

one_star_reviews.text: To buy water, the bar near the entrance doesn't work; you have to go back outside to re-enter with water... I give them a zero.

A company that receives subsidies from every autonomous community and has a fraudulent customer service system... Four tickets purchased and paid for online, justified with order number, bank statement, etc., the Yelmo cinema platform crashes, as usual, and nobody resolves the issue. To top it off, the tickets are still on sale. The 902 number has endless hold times, the cinema's phone number is redirected to a mobile phone that's always switched off and has a full voicemail, and the email and contact link seem to work, but don't... A disgraceful company that pockets millions of euros and is either incapable or unwilling to resolve this type of problem that they themselves are causing.

They have a terrible company policy towards customers. When I went to buy tickets, I selected my date on the Yelmo website because if it refreshed, my movie date changed. I paid 17 euros to go see a movie, which was a real struggle since I'm not a military employee, but rather exploited for a paltry 400 euros. To make matters worse, almost two hours before the movie, I contacted Yelmo because, surprisingly, they don't have a phone number to talk to. So I wrote to them, explained what happened, and they told me they couldn't change it due to company policy. So I told Yelmo to enjoy my 17 euros because I'm at work at the time of the movie. I won't be choosing this cinema again because it makes me sad for the consumers, who are the ones who pay their salaries, and on top of that, with how expensive movies are these days, they're throwing money away for no reason. Please add a clause that allows you to change the date of your ticket at least one hour before the show.
Disgraceful. Dirty. Unpleasant and arrogant staff. Zero quality.

The cinema is fine, the films look good, and the place is clean, but my rating is for a specific guy who works there. He's blond, thin, and has (I think) light eyes. He's very rude and arrogant (in my opinion, obviously). I was in the theater watching the film and ran out of drinks. I went to buy another one and stood by the side where the drinks are ordered and the queue forms (but inside the cinema). Seeing that this guy was about two meters away from me and wasn't serving anyone at the time (he was going to call someone), and he wasn't looking, I said, "Excuse me," so he'd look. When I finally got him to look, I asked if it was possible to order from there? (I repeat, I was already in the film and I ran out of drinks.) He didn't know if it was possible or not, and the guy said no… and as soon as he answered, he ignored me and started serving the people (whom he was calling from the queue outside the cinema). I said, "Excuse me! So I have to queue again?" And he says yes... he turns back to those people and starts acting cocky, laughing with a look on his face that says... what do I have to put up with? I didn't like that attitude or that lack of manners at all. I wasn't rude or impolite at any point, quite the opposite... I was just asking to see if it was possible to order it there, and if not, I wouldn't buy it, that's all. But the guy's behavior and attitude really bothered me. He might have been having a bad day, but you can't act so arrogantly towards customers—without them, cinemas don't survive. I'm not mentioning his name because I don't know it, just so you know, but I didn't like it at all.

🚨⚽️ ATTENTION, UD LAS PALMAS FANS! ⚽️🚨

I want to publicly share my experience with the official UD Las Palmas store at the Gran Canaria Stadium because I don't want this to happen to any other fan.

I bought an official jersey online for €65, clearly selecting size M.

When I received the package at home, I found a jersey that, in practice, seems much smaller than I expected for a size M. To the point that I can barely wear it.

I went to the store looking for an explanation and a solution. And what was the manager's response?

👉 That the jerseys from that season run smaller.

👉 That they are not responsible for it.

👉 And that what I should have done was go to the store in person and try it on before buying it.

🤦‍♂️ Excuse me?

If I buy a t-shirt online and select size M, the least I expect is to receive a t-shirt that corresponds to that size, or at least for the store to clearly state that this model runs particularly small.

We're talking about €65.

And what infuriates me most isn't just the t-shirt. It's the response I received when I went to complain: "That's just how the sizing is, and we can't do anything about it."

Well, I can do something: share my experience and warn other fans.

💛💙 Before buying online from the official store, CAREFULLY check the actual measurements of the t-shirt and the exchange/return policy.

Because after paying €65, receiving a t-shirt that doesn't fit, and being told that the solution was to have gone to try it on beforehand, the feeling as a customer is one of utter helplessness.

I am deeply disappointed and consider the service I received to be unacceptable.

📢 Fans, please be aware: before buying, check the sizing carefully.

Because being an official store shouldn't just mean selling jerseys. It should also mean taking responsibility for the customer when a problem arises.

💛💙 UD Las Palmas: The fans deserve a better response.

one_star_reviews.text:
I want to document what happened on the 29th so that those in charge know how it was handled.

A few days earlier, I had gone to this copy shop to have photos copied and laminated. On that occasion, they did the job correctly: the photos from my phone were cropped and framed. So, on the 29th, I returned for the same service.

That day, a different employee helped me. I explained what I needed, and she started working. At one point, she said, "Just a moment," and went to get another colleague. The colleague who came was the one who had helped me a few days before.

She explained that the managers had reprimanded them and that they could no longer help as much as before because they had to be available for other customers and tasks. At that moment, I was alone, although other customers came in later.

They also told me that this assistance had to be charged separately. I didn't understand the change because they had provided the exact same service a few days earlier without charging extra. I didn't agree with the fact that it was now being charged separately.

They finally made the copies, but not like before. The photos from my phone came out with text, and since they hadn't cropped or framed them, they were useless to me. Even so, they told me I had to pay for the copies even though they were useless. I said I would pay without a problem.

At the counter, I asked how much I owed and requested a complaint form. I asked for it more than five times and was repeatedly refused. The same employee questioned what complaint I wanted to make and said she had already explained everything. I wanted to file a formal complaint and kept asking for it.

Another colleague told me to write a review so the managers would see it. I wanted to file a formal complaint. When they refused, I warned that I would call the police if they didn't give me the form.

Right then, the same employee I was having trouble with told me it didn't matter, that she wasn't going to charge me anything, and she took the photos I had taken and tore them up in front of me. She told me that she wasn't going to charge me after all and that she wasn't going to sell them to me.

I thought her attitude was terrible and left the store. Afterwards, I called the police and arranged to meet the officers at the door to go back inside with them.

Once inside with the police, the situation worsened: the employee said it was all a lie, that I hadn't been in the store, hadn't bought anything, and wasn't even a customer. I consider it serious that she denied everything in front of the officers and dismissed me as a liar.

I told her that the security camera footage could be reviewed, which would show my presence, the copies, what had happened, and that I had torn up the photos.

The police officer explained that they were there to mediate and that she should give me a complaint form. She finally gave it to me; I was able to file the complaint, it was signed, and I have my copy.

I couldn't explain everything in such detail in the official complaint, so I'm also making this public statement.

I'm not writing this review simply because some photos turned out badly. I was completely dissatisfied with the entire experience: the change of policy regarding a service they had performed correctly just days before, the separate charge, the fact that the copies were useless, the initial demand to pay for them, and, above all, the repeated refusal to provide me with a complaint form.

Even worse was that, when I went to the police station to file a complaint, they denied that I had been there and claimed I was lying.

I hope those in charge will review what happened. The establishment has security cameras. A disagreement with a customer can be resolved by explaining the terms of service; I find it unacceptable to have to call the police to file a complaint and, furthermore, to be accused of lying in front of the officers. I am leaving this review so that those in charge are aware of what happened and can review how things were handled that day.

He simply left me there with my two children, without any solution, for something that could have been avoided with a simple question: “Physical SIM or eSIM?”

When I told him that this was appalling customer service and asked to speak to the manager, he pointed to the employee next to him and said that he was the supervisor. Instead of trying to resolve the situation, the supervisor laughed in front of me.

I've never seen such a reaction to something so simple. I wasn't asking for any special treatment, just to buy a Prepaid M plan with an eSIM.

A complete lack of professionalism, respect, and customer service.

one_star_reviews.text: Taulí Hospital, Sabadell. September 28, 2026. My wife has been in the emergency room since 4:00 PM and they still haven't called her. She has intense, unbearable pain in her knee and a swollen leg. It's 12:30 AM on the 29th and she's been there for over 8 hours. This is a disaster. I don't know if there's a staff shortage. Unfortunately, something is clearly wrong with the Catalan public healthcare system. It's an absolute absurdity. It's not normal to wait more than 8 hours (at least not yet) to see a doctor. It's dramatic and infuriating. The argument from the emergency room staff is that they attend to patients according to their vital importance. Judging by other users' reviews, these situations have become the norm. In other words, they decide in triage whether a patient is a priority or not. Therefore, patients considered non-priority have to wait, no matter what, for more than 8 hours. We come to the hospital for a reason. And does the Minister of Health know what's happening in her hospitals?

Outrageous! After arriving around 10:15 pm, I waited almost three hours without receiving any response or update (after triage).
Far from projecting professionalism, the nursing area resembled a children's playground. They even started singing "Happy Birthday" after midnight to a nurse named Ana (who clearly thinks she's in charge) to celebrate her 24 years at the center, while the patients waited. To make matters worse, at one point the staff—or rather, the playground, whatever you want to call it—suddenly vanished, leaving only the young woman who appeared to be a student nurse and another colleague alone at the station. This demonstrated absolute disorganization and a complete lack of empathy and professionalism.

Our experience with Cemuproan has been quite disappointing. We met a cat at an adoption event and, being interested in adopting it, they told us to contact them via WhatsApp for information and to begin the process.

The problem is that, on two occasions, we've written requesting information and they've simply ignored us, without giving us any response or explanation.

Frankly, I find it very frustrating that someone showing genuine interest in adopting and providing a home for an animal doesn't even receive a reply. We completely understand that they may be very busy, but responding, even just to say "we can't help you right now," shouldn't be so difficult.

We're talking about people who want to adopt, not just any inquiries. If someone is interested in one of the animals they have available for adoption, the least they expect is to receive information and know what steps to take.

I hope they improve communication with people interested in adopting, because situations like this can cause someone who is willing to give an animal a home to give up due to lack of attention.

Scam. I'll never buy from them again, and their advertising will be just as bad... a thousand attempts to book a hotel... impossible in the summer, and in the winter, none of the hotels I've called can give me a reservation, no matter the day.
Another one says Monday to Thursday. Another says a minimum of two nights and it's included in the package... here I am, about to expire, and with no solution.
They keep your money, it's impossible to use the voucher, and you look terrible in front of the person you give it to.

It's impossible to make a reservation; either they don't offer it on weekends, or the options we could have enjoyed aren't available. Plus, it's way below the price the box cost. It's all downsides. Don't buy it or give it as a gift. It's money that just goes into this company's coffers because the expiration date passes, and you're hoping to find something decent that's available so you can actually enjoy the gift. Well, I won't be giving it as a gift or recommending it.

These gift boxes are a complete lie. You try to redeem them, and no hotel or guesthouse will accept them. They make a thousand excuses; it's a massive scam by the company that sells them, the shops that sell them, and the hotels that make promises and then turn their backs on these customers.
It's a complete scam, thousands of attempts trying to reserve a spot, in places that aren't worth what was paid for the treasure chest, only to end up losing it because it has expired.

A very disappointing experience. The salesperson's attitude and courtesy left much to be desired, and the options presented to me for purchasing the vehicle seemed opaque and quite strange.

I inquired at several Alfa Romeo dealerships, and none offered similar terms. Ultimately, I bought the same vehicle, at the same price, with more extras, and it was mine from the moment I drove it off the lot—something this dealership had told me wouldn't be the case, as their proposal stated the vehicle would remain theirs for 2-3 months.

It's a shame, because I had very high hopes for Alfa Romeo, but the experience with this dealership was enough to make me choose another option. I recommend always comparing terms with other dealerships before agreeing to anything.

There are very few good things to say about this dealership, in fact, none at all, because they are complete swindlers and liars. If you're thinking of buying a car from Auto 88, I would think twice because if your car breaks down and you have a warranty, they won't take any responsibility, maybe after a few months, since they will try everything possible to avoid paying for the repairs and make up excuses to make it seem like the buyer is at fault. My car broke down when the clutch failed, and Auto 88's justification, without even seeing it in person, was that I used it a lot or downshifted too much. Not even the most clueless person on the planet knows that a clutch can break just like that. They made me wait more than two weeks after they reported the clutch failure, and then on top of that, they said it would take another 10 days. Furthermore, the car was only two months old, and they claimed it had been inspected. They are a bunch of frauds. I think if you buy a car from Auto 88, pray it doesn't break down. These scammers won't take you seriously because they have no interest in repairing cars. It's obvious they claim there's a warranty, but they simply don't feel like fixing them. You'd better think twice before buying a car from Auto 88; they're a bunch of swindlers.

SCAMMERS; I purchased two lots at auction through Templum Fine Art Auctions and paid in full.

For months, despite my follow-ups, I received only vague and contradictory answers: alleged logistical problems, never any specific documentation, never a real date. The carrier, ThePackengers, even told me they weren't authorized to collect the lots and were waiting for Templum's approval. So the delay wasn't my fault.

I finally hired a lawyer, and only then did I finally get my two lots back. I'm now filing a lawsuit for damages. I've also written to the tax authorities to report the situation, as the invoice, too, never arrived.

In my opinion, this whole thing seems like a system designed to wear you down: they take your money, invent obstacles, and wait for you to lose patience. If the amount is small, many people give up, and that's probably what they're hoping for.

My advice to anyone reading this review: before buying from them, think twice. If you've already paid, don't waste any time and consult a lawyer immediately. Don't let them take advantage of you.

I called them on Friday. A girl answered the phone, and I asked about a specific shoe size (44). She said there was no problem, they had the same model (they made me tell them the size, model, brand, and whether they were Velcro). I told them I would come the next morning to pick them up and pay for them. When I arrived, they told me they had sold all the shoes in the size I requested. They don't keep their word.

Because that same week, we had a problem when I went to buy some white pants. They told me that if I needed a different size, I should call and they would set aside the pants in the size we needed (the pants had already been paid for). That same day, we called and they said there was no problem, we could come and exchange them. We went that same afternoon, and they didn't have the size. We had to wait for them to get more.

It's one thing for this to happen once, but for it to happen twice is a disgrace. I will never trust this store again. It's better to go to other, more reputable stores. I bought my shoes somewhere else.

Response to the reply:

So why, when I called to order the shoes, did the person on the phone say they had plenty of that size and that it wasn't a problem, that it was rare to sell them? Look, they're unprofessional, they're shameful. It's a shame I can't give them zero stars, which is what they deserve.

I've been waiting three weeks for a simple quote, and after speaking with two different salespeople and visiting the dealership in person twice, I still haven't received any response. I went because I was genuinely interested in buying the car and wanted to configure it with more extras than the standard features. I believe that after three weeks, the least I could do is receive a quote or a response, even if the configuration I requested ultimately isn't possible.
I also mentioned that I'd like to see and test drive a matte gray model, and from the beginning, it was all just stalling. To this day, I haven't been able to test drive it, they haven't sent me the quote, and no one has contacted me unless I've actively pursued them. If the car can't be configured with the extras I wanted, if they can't obtain them, or if they're simply not interested in selling it, they should say so clearly. What's unacceptable is wasting the customer's time and giving them the runaround for weeks. In the end, I had to find another dealership, where they actually helped me, gave me the quote, and did what I needed.

We arrived at the dealership with high expectations to buy a Seat Arona. We had arranged to meet with the salesman at 5:00 PM to see the car, but the first thing that happened was that he didn't see us until 6:30 PM, and the car wasn't even in the showroom—the first lie. He told us he would contact us to let us know when they would have it. We then scheduled an inspection of our car, saying they would call us, but after two months, we haven't received a response, nor have they even bothered to make a call. The salesman's service was appalling. He showed us a car he had in the showroom that wasn't even close to the one we were going to buy and didn't bother to explain anything. He unlocked the car remotely and said, "Here it is, take a look." Zero professionalism. I absolutely do not recommend this dealership!
By the way, we already have the Arona we wanted from another dealership. Thanks!

It's a real shame to pay so much money for a car and then have the worst service center I've ever encountered.

I absolutely do not recommend buying any car from this dealership, much less taking it there for maintenance.

The salesman Marc responded to us in a very rude manner, speaking with extreme arrogance and repeatedly saying that we had wasted his time. Given his lack of professionalism, we told him that we would obviously buy the car from another Suzuki dealership. He replied that it was better that way, that he didn't want customers like us, and that we should never return to the dealership because he didn't want us there. I want to emphasize that we treated him with respect at all times. We simply told him we wanted to wait two months, and this was his response. Appalling customer service. Obviously, we will not be buying any cars here.

UPDATE: After I left an initial negative review (with the message above), not content with having already demonstrated such a lack of professionalism, he thought it appropriate to send me a message thanking me for the review and saying that "Karma always comes back around." Zero professionalism. Do not buy from this dealership.

A complete disappointment and an experience that has left us utterly outraged. We bought an air conditioner with installation included, and we've been waiting for a solution for a year and four months now, as the units haven't worked since the day they were installed.

The most infuriating thing is the absolute lack of customer service. When there are problems, they don't answer the phone and they don't reply to emails. It's impossible to get a clear answer. After making the purchase, we feel completely abandoned and like we've wasted our money.

To make matters worse, during the installation, the installers themselves told us they didn't have the necessary certification for handling fluorinated gases in air conditioning equipment. This, obviously, caused us even more concern.

We're fed up with waiting, trying to contact them, and not getting a solution after so much time. It's one thing to have a problem with a unit, but quite another to be unable to contact the company that sold and installed it when the problem arises.

The experience has been awful from beginning to end. We would never buy from them again and recommend that anyone considering doing so or hiring them for installation look for other companies that are professionals in the sector and don't just make empty promises, especially regarding installation and after-sales service.

After 1 year and 4 months, we are still waiting for a solution, which will be determined in court because we have a legal case pending. For us, the experience has been simply unacceptable.

We reported the issue immediately, before leaving the premises. An employee personally inspected the damage and instructed us to file a complaint via email. We followed her instructions, sent a formal complaint with photographs of the damage, and requested that they cover the cost of the repairs.

Furthermore, we have photographs taken before handing over the vehicle that prove its condition beforehand.

And what was Park & ​​Fly's response? NONE. ABSOLUTE SILENCE.

Not an explanation. Not a response to the complaint. Not a proposed solution. Not even the minimum attention one would expect from a company to which you entrust your vehicle for several days.

What's truly worrying is not just finding your car damaged, but realizing that when you file a formal complaint and request a solution, you don't even receive a reply.

When you hire a vehicle storage service, you expect your car to be returned in the condition in which you handed it over and that, if a problem arises, the company will respond and handle the issue professionally. Our experience has been the exact opposite.

We find it unacceptable that we have to chase after a company to get an answer about damage we noticed when we picked up our vehicle and reported immediately.

Therefore, our recommendation to anyone considering hiring Park & ​​Fly is clear: think very carefully before leaving your car with them. Take photos of absolutely everything before handing it over and keep all evidence and communications. Don't assume that if a problem arises, you'll receive the attention and response you expect.

We followed the procedure they indicated and are still waiting. This review isn't the result of a misunderstanding or an incident we chose to ignore: it's the consequence of a formal complaint that remains unanswered.

We will not entrust our vehicle to them again, nor do we recommend their services in light of what happened. A customer's trust is earned through the service provided, but it's also demonstrated when things go wrong. And, in our case, Park & ​​Fly has yet to prove it.

We are publishing this experience so that other users can make an informed decision before hiring their services. We are still waiting for a response and a solution regarding the cost of the damages caused, and we will take legal action to ensure that happens.

Until then, if you're considering leaving your car there, let our experience serve as a warning.

Finally, they returned the computer with the supposedly destroyed screen, completely ruined, and the computer overheats uncontrollably when I use it. They recommended I only use the original charger, the only one I've ever used, and on top of that, they blamed me for the damage, constantly shirking responsibility, making excuses, and inventing convoluted explanations to avoid taking responsibility. Finally, after complaining once again and not knowing what else to do, they gave me a refund of 150 euros (the new screen cost over 500 euros, plus labor, around 160 euros). The customer service experience was exhausting and unprofessional, and I clearly do not recommend this place to anyone, nor do I ever intend to return. TERRIBLE SERVICE.

one_star_reviews.text: I don’t think people choose places like this based on reviews, and you can’t make the rating any worse here. But I came here at 4 p.m. with a perianal abscess; it’s now 2 a.m., I’m sitting in a smelly (a girl vomited into a trash can) waiting room, and they’re telling me I have to wait another 2 hours for the blood tests — so, in total, in 12 hours — and if they’re fine, I’ll go home. I don’t understand why I can’t get the tests done and come back in a day — what an awful thing that I have to sit in the cold, feeling sick, without sleep or food for 12 hours. This doesn’t improve my condition. P.S. The doctors are good, but the system is awful. If you’re here, be patient.

I came here with severe asthma And a very active head cold. I couldn’t sleep at all the night before. I initially was stuck in a 10 x 10‘ waiting room with eight other people And waited about 40 minutes. Finally, In despair because I could not breathe, I told the admittance person that I could not breathe. She consulted several people and I was shown to another admittance person who told me she did not speak English. She asked some basic questions and I was put in another waiting room without explanation. There I waited for a long time before a woman took me back into another room and asked me questions. She two did not speak English and even though A translation app, she did not use it My phone did not Have Wi-Fi so I could not use my translation app I asked several people what the password was but they just shrugged. I desperately wanted to tell her my symptoms but she was more intent on filling out the form and raise her hand to tell me to stop talking. Finally, she hooked me up to some oxygen. Then I was taken for A chest x-ray and waited in that waiting room while a bunch of technicians stood in the hall chatting, while I and another patient waited. After the chest x-ray I was ushered back to another room without explanation. I waited but was starving because I hadn’t eaten anything and told that there was a vending machine. After coming back from getting food from the Vending machine, I started to leave but they told me I couldn’t. I had to pay €760 to leave, but I did get seven prescriptions. That was the only saving Grace, but the experience was horrible.

one_star_reviews.text: I needed a new screen protector for my iPhone. The employee was very preoccupied with his own phone and sent me away, telling me to come back in two hours when he would receive a delivery. Two hours later, he applied the screen protector. I showed him that it was crooked and didn't cover the entire screen, and that there was also dust underneath it. He said that in 24 hours the bubble would be gone and that it was normal for the protector to be crooked, as it was typical for this model that the protector didn't extend to the edge. I was speechless; I've never encountered such rudeness, and I certainly didn't want to argue with this impolite man over 10 euros. The dust, or rather the bubble, is still there, by the way. Absolutely not recommended!!

My wife and I visited the store because we both needed new screen protectors for our iPhones. The employee was busy with his own phone, so there was no return greeting.

The old screen protector was quickly removed, and the new one was applied in no time. The employee was also on the phone with someone else at the same time.

The result of this "specialized work" is clearly visible in the photos. My comment that the protector hadn't been applied correctly was dismissed with the words, "It'll be fine in 24 hours."

I'm writing this review 24 hours later, and I took the photos two minutes ago. I considered going back to the store to have it fixed, but it's not worth an hour's drive there and back. It's a shame; I've never seen such shoddy work.

I personally won't be going back to this store.

one_star_reviews.text: I've been using this medical center for 20 years, which is practically the entire time I've been on the island, since after that, there's only the Parque Hospital. Aside from a couple of doctors who are decent professionals, there are some pretty regrettable aspects to being a private service. To begin with, the reception staff, with the exception of one Latina woman, are completely lacking in friendliness, empathy, availability, and even smiles, even when it comes to charging you. It seems like everything bothers them, but they don't care. You can spend days trying to call because nobody answers. Thankfully, the website makes it a bit easier now. I don't know why I even went to the rehabilitation service because it didn't help me at all three times, so it was a waste of money, not to mention the complete lack of friendliness from the person who attended to me. Sometimes you can wait for hours to see a specialist, but that's the least of it. I recently had dental treatment, and very soon after that, I have a procedure with general anesthesia, so I'm requesting the evaluation report for the procedure because it could interfere with my health. Regarding the procedure, about 10 days ago I requested the report online, in person, by email, WhatsApp, and phone. They still haven't sent it, even though I specified that it's an urgent case due to an upcoming procedure. Each time I made my request, they replied with "it will arrive," "you have to request it online," "we understand,"... they seemed more like chatbots than people. But there's still no word on the report. Any other private clinic gives it to me immediately. I don't know if that's professionalism, but it certainly doesn't seem normal. In fact, they're creating a huge problem for me, since I have an anesthesiologist who asks me daily for an urgent report on my current treatment status, and we still don't know where it is. So, I think this is the worst situation I've ever experienced. The problem is that there aren't many other private clinic options on this island. You just have to hope you're always okay, because even paying doesn't provide adequate service... speechless...

Breach of BMW Premium Selection Official Warranty on Vehicle with 41,000 km
I want to express my absolute outrage with the after-sales service. I purchased a BMW X3 15 months ago from this dealership under the BMW Premium Selection certification. The vehicle now has 41,000 km and requires replacement of the starter motor, tire pressure monitoring system, and both 12V batteries.

Despite the fact that the 24-month warranty for the program is still fully valid, the dealership has presented me with a quote of €3,500, thus evading its contractual responsibility. The Premium Selection terms stipulate full coverage of mechanical and electronic parts. Passing this cost on to the customer is an unacceptable example of unfair business practice. I urge the dealership management to review this case immediately and apply the coverage to which I am legally and contractually entitled before I pursue legal action and file a complaint with consumer protection agencies.

I am very disappointed with the service. I contacted the lawyer on September 10th regarding a family law matter involving insurance and real estate. After sending her all the documentation, I had to follow up several times by phone and email to get a response. On September 23rd, I finally managed to speak with her, and she agreed to send me a quote, which I finally received after repeatedly requesting it.

On September 27th and 28th, I requested the bank account number to make the payment, but received no response. On September 29th, after calling again, she told me she would prepare the case file and send a Mediation, Arbitration, and Conciliation Service (MASC) to the other party. However, on September 30th, when I contacted her again because I still hadn't received the contract, her secretary told me she couldn't see me and that I should wait or find another lawyer.
What has disappointed me most is the lack of communication and follow-up, especially considering there was an important deadline that ended today. I didn't even receive the call the lawyer had promised to make. In such a delicate situation, I expected professionalism, communication, and commitment. Unfortunately, my experience has been very negative.

They change doctors as often as you change clothes. My doctor, Janet, was wonderful; I was very happy with her. It's infuriating how patients get so used to a doctor, spend a considerable amount of time with them, and then suddenly they're switched doctors overnight.

For almost nine months, they gave us their word, time and again, that they would lease us a plot of land. They explicitly encouraged us to move forward, to invest, and to complete all the paperwork, assuring us that everything would be finalized. Just this week, in the morning, they confirmed to me: "All we need is the permit from the City Council, go ahead."

Based on their commitment, I dedicated time, effort, and nearly €1,000 to a feasibility study, consultations with the Generalitat (Catalan government), and project preparation. I already had a meeting scheduled with the City Council and their architect for Monday. And just two hours after informing them, they called to tell me no, that they had decided to use the land for themselves.

There is no explanation, no apology, no acknowledgment of anything. It's simply over.

This behavior has zero ethics, zero professionalism, and zero respect for people's trust, effort, and money. If they had no intention of fulfilling their promise from the beginning, the honest thing to do would have been to say so before letting us proceed. It's about keeping your word and treating others with dignity. They didn't do that here.

I'm personally extremely disappointed: I've spent almost a year trying to build my project, and not only have they failed to deliver, but they've wasted my time, money, and trust. No one deserves to be treated this way.

If you're considering doing business with them, please take my review into account.

one_star_reviews.text: I've never seen a bigger rip-off. I bought all my appliances from this company (Infiniton) on the recommendation of my local distributor, who claimed it was a local, friendly company with good products at reasonable prices. The result? A Chinese middleman. I had a few problems, like the washing machine, which was a completely different color from the rest of the stainless steel appliances I bought, and I had to exchange it. But the biggest disaster was the technician's visit. Let me explain. I requested help on their website to remove the double glass door of the oven so I could clean it, since the instructions said it could be removed from the top. Very politely, they generated an RMA for me, as is their usual practice, and asked me what the problem was with the oven. I told them IT HAD NO PROBLEM (it was written down), that I just wanted to remove the glass, and that the instructions were wrong and I couldn't do it (I attached photos of the glass and the instructions). Without even calling me or explaining how to proceed, they told me they were going to send a technician. Okay, the technician comes, admits the instructions are wrong and that the disassembly is completely different and rather complicated, and in about five minutes he sorts it out. But wait, since there's no fault, he wants to charge me €59 (for an oven that costs €200). I tell him that doesn't seem right and that I'm not going to pay, and 15 days later I get a call from headquarters saying that I specifically requested the visit and that I have to pay. I tell them to check the chat to see if it's true that I was the one who requested the technician or if they sent him without calling me or giving me proper instructions. The woman says I have to pay, period. When I refuse, she sends me an email stating that they're suspending the warranty due to my non-payment and that they reserve the right to take legal action (which wouldn't be successful since they can't prove that I requested the technician). In any case, since I'm more responsible than they are, I wrote to them again and asked them to send me the invoice and the chat log of our conversation, and that I would pay and that would be the end of it. The invoice appeared in no time, but there are always problems getting the chat log. I paid to demonstrate my responsibility. And if they had apologized for their mistake, I would have paid sooner. So everyone can judge as they wish and decide who acted right or wrong. (P.S. To this day, the chat log still hasn't appeared: how curious.)

INFINITON! WARNING TO BUYERS: Non-existent warranty, fabricated charges, and threats.

Don't even think about buying this brand. Within a week of installing the air conditioner, it starts malfunctioning. They send a technician claiming the visit is free, and then they slap on a fabricated charge for installation, even though they signed their own report stating the charge went to the supplier.

If you refuse to pay an illegal amount for which they never provided a prior estimate, they resort to harassment: threatening you with lawsuits and sending documents stating they are suspending your warranty. A company with such disgraceful business practices and such bullying customer service is doomed. With this reputation, they won't be around much longer.

one_star_reviews.text: They're a bunch of scammers. We had an accident and they kept our money. They didn't fight for our case; it was absolutely shameful. And on top of that, they gave us the money however they wanted so they could pocket even more. Never hire them as lawyers because they're all a bunch of scammers.

I promise you that all the bad reviews these people have are completely true, and the good ones are just there to inflate the average, which should be 0 stars.

To begin with, they make you pay 90 euros to handle your case. They call you desperately the first day, and once they've got you hooked, they stop calling. Then they assign you a lawyer, and the lawyer doesn't care about anything. They don't understand a thing, and in my case, I waited a year for the forensic doctor. They changed lawyers three or four times. Ana Hernández was the one who confused me completely, telling me not to pay attention to the emails from the other insurance company's offer. Then they deposited the money with the court, and she didn't know what to tell me anymore. That was the first one. Then Pol Olaya, who they used as a puppet, was the second, and I don't know if he ended up leaving, but then they assigned me another puppet whose name I don't even remember. This scum is pathetic. I hope no one else uses them. Please, at least read the reviews carefully, something I didn't do, and I regret it 100%.

After an accident in December 2025, I contacted them online. What I should know is that Google recommends whoever pays the most, not who is the best in the industry.

My experience with them went like this: I signed the contract, changed three email addresses, and the lawyer informed me that they were going to close my case because the "causal link has been broken." But without even trying to take the insurance company to court, without telling me I had this option, only that "nothing more can be done."
You have to understand that we're talking about a pretty serious accident, with a leave of absence of more than nine months (and I'm still off work), and that the company doesn't care if they lose that much money; they care if they can get their percentage as quickly as possible.

LE: Let's see if we understand each other: I'm not saying you didn't inform me. You did it, but you directly informed me of your decision to drop the case, saying that nothing more can be done and that I've lost everything because of the infamous "nexus" or whatever.

Imagine a lawyer, who is precisely supposed to defend your rights and who is supposed to be involved in these kinds of cases, abandoning you like this. And all because it's easier to consider the case lost than to continue looking for alternatives or ways to defend it.

In the end, after suffering an accident in which I was completely innocent, I find myself potentially losing thousands of euros simply because it's decided that nothing more can be done, without actually going all the way to defend my rights.

Greetings to Adrian, and thanks for making me think about suicide, thinking that with my disability and the lasting effects I've suffered, I'll be left without any compensation whatsoever.

one_star_reviews.text: It's shameful to have a festival in Granada that isn't about culture, leisure, and fun for the people... but rather a scam to make money disguised as fun and culture. You go to other festivals and don't feel nearly as bad as you do at this one... lack of services, they even charge you to change the name on your wristband, beer and mixed drinks are priced for the wealthy, poor lighting, and the dangerous traffic jams at the entrance and exit. I wish there were security checks to report this. THIS IS THE LAST YEAR WE'RE COMING BACK. It's a money grab. And on top of that, this year it's in support of Israel... disgusting.

This festival has steadily declined in its pursuit of squeezing money out of people by offering increasingly lower quality. The bands were good, but the poor organization, overcrowding, exorbitant prices, the inability to pay in cash (which we assume is illegal), endless queues at the exit creating a bottleneck that, in case of an emergency, would cause us all to be crushed, theft when changing wristband names, etc., they try to squeeze money out of you for every little thing they can think of. I'M NEVER COMING BACK. You feel like a walking wallet, receiving no decent service. A bunch of shameless crooks more concerned with making money than fixing the problems that have plagued it in previous years.

Very disappointing and disrespectful to the client.
I booked an appointment online for lip micropigmentation, taking advantage of an offer advertised on the clinic's website. The appointment was confirmed, and when I arrived, I waited approximately half an hour at the clinic. After all that time, I received a WhatsApp message informing me that they were canceling my appointment because they disagreed with the price I had booked.
I find this completely unacceptable. If a clinic advertises an offer and allows online booking at that price, the least they can do is honor the booking and the advertised conditions. It is not the client's responsibility if they later disagree with the price they themselves published.
The experience was one of utter lack of professionalism, organization, and respect for the client's time. If they don't want to offer the service at that price, they should remove the offer from their website and not allow clients to make bookings only to cancel them once they are already there.

I hope they review the way they manage their promotions and reservations, because situations like this create an image of misleading advertising and cause a complete loss of trust in the establishment.

STAY AWAY - INCOMPETENT OR THIEVES - UPDATED REVIEW

This is a genuine horror story.

This company and I had a signed agreement for my divorce case with defined costs and expectations. After the legal case, the lawyer gave me a surprise bill we had never discussed or agreed to in writing which was triple the amount of the approved cost. They also quoted outdated laws about why I should pay this fee. I looked up the law and stated that I had never signed this agreement nor that the law was in effect anymore. At which point the lawyer (fernando) admitted he had made up the number, and we had no written agreement, and he asked me to pay more anyway.

There are only two explanations for a business billing you 300% more than the agreed upon amount, either malicious practices or incompetence. I assumed it was good intentioned incompetence.

I paid an additional 7,500 euro because I felt bad for Fernando's incompetence. But then I discovered that his errors had also hurt my own lawsuit through failure to manage my case in the court and with the other attorney. 6 months later, I am still paying other law firms to solve the repercussions of his errors.

Here are some of the errors:

- In an early trial, Fernando asked me to bring written evidence of communications. The court threw the evidence out because they were not translated from English to Spanish. He should know that the court requires translations.

- Failure to enforce the agreed upon vaccinations of my daughter. Despite putting a vaccination agreement in the divorce agreement, Fernando failed to get cooperation from the other party, and began to use this as leverage to try and make me pay more to do work beyond our defined scope.

- Failure to amend an error by the court regarding asset separation, while he was my representing attorney. This was never communicated to me, I'm only finding out about it 5 months later from my new attorney. This means I cannot enforce the agreed upon asset division with a hostile ex-wife who is now effectively stealing from me.

Looking back, the only reason I continued with Fernando is that I was so tired of my horrible ex-wife that I put up with his law firm.

They cannot correspond by email professionally. He will miss critical details of your case. And he will try and steal from you.

Fernando is a legal bully who will gaslight you when you are desperate. He is now sending me papers to extort me for more money. Thankfully, I have plenty of evidence of his malpractice and have hired attorneys to countersue him. Fernando, I will see you in court.

---

OLD REVIEW
In the end, I cannot recommend this attorney to other people.

From my experience: the operators are well-intentioned, but take on too many clients, resulting in poor attention to your case. The attorney regularly avoided addressing critical topics, and in the end left me with a divorce convenio that was misrepresented during negotiations and created a lot of persistent problems that I will have to deal with for years.

After having them handle my divorce case I was so frustrated by delays, misrepresentation of the convenio, and failure to execute on critical topics that I changed firms. The difference in professionalism and attentiveness to detail makes me regret hiring this firm for my divorce. I think I will have challenges due to this error for many years.

The staff is nice. The counsel genuinely cares. But the operational support is a red flag.

I've just received a lawsuit from Fernando insisting I pay more to his company and I will be countersuing him for malpractice. See you in court.

one_star_reviews.text: This store is a disgrace. I bought something online and they haven't shipped it. They've failed to meet the delivery timeframe stated on their website. I contacted them for a response, but they haven't replied, and I'm left without my money, without my shoes, without the shipment, without anything. I wanted them to cancel the order so I could get my money back, and they won't even do that. It's shameful. This store is going to face serious legal action.

⭐ A very disappointing experience

This summer, I bought a handbag for €49 at Mele Salou, without any discount. I've only used it a few times (between three and six) and it's already broken along the strap and seam, as you can see in the photos.

I went to the store to explain what happened and find a solution, but my experience was very disappointing. They refused to exchange the bag or refund my money, arguing that it broke from use and that, if I used it, it was normal for it to break.

Frankly, I don't think it's normal for a €49 handbag to deteriorate like this after so little use, and even less so for the store's response to blame the customer without offering any solution.

Furthermore, I bought two beach dresses there for €29 each and later found the same dresses at the Salou market for €21.

What disappointed me most wasn't just that the bag was defective, but the way they handled my complaint and the treatment I received. I expected them to at least inspect the product and find a solution.

Based on my experience, I won't buy from this store again and I can't recommend it. Before buying, especially expensive items, I recommend thoroughly checking the quality and comparing prices.

On Thursday, I went to the emergency room with my daughter, so far so good.

The thing is, when I called on Friday to make an appointment because she had a fever of 38 degrees Celsius (100.4 degrees Fahrenheit), the receptionist rudely told me they weren't going to see my daughter because she had already been seen the day before! I asked for the doctor's report, and even though he told me he wasn't going to give it to me because they're no longer obligated to, it wasn't even posted on the health center's website!
It's a disgrace, I've never seen anything like it! In Barcelona, ​​they've always seen my daughter if I go two days in a row! And even with a fever of 38 degrees Celsius (100.4 degrees Fahrenheit), which, according to the receptionist, isn't enough to warrant an appointment... Her words were: "I'm not going to tell you about the high fever so they'll see her again, otherwise you'll go to the hospital or your private health insurance company!" I was absolutely stunned!

“Albert and his absolutely deplorable customer service”

I called the CAP (Primary Care Center) in the afternoon to carry out an administrative procedure. I had some questions, which is completely understandable considering that, depending on who you speak to at Social Security, you receive different and often contradictory instructions.

Unfortunately, Albert's telephone service not only failed to help me resolve my doubts, but his attitude was completely inappropriate. He was despotic, arrogant, and unhelpful, speaking in a condescending tone throughout.

It's one thing to be unable to resolve a matter, but quite another to treat a caller seeking help with that level of superiority and contempt. If you can't answer a question, the least that can be expected of someone who serves the public is courtesy, patience, and a willingness to guide, not to make the user feel like they are bothering them by asking.

I find it especially worrying that someone who answers calls in a public health service communicates with people in this way. I don't question whether he might not have had the answer I needed; I completely question the manner and attitude with which he addressed me.

They're always late and the service is terrible. They're always late, either at 3:00 PM or 7:00 PM.

The care provided by some of the nurses leaves much to be desired.

One has five people waiting, while the one next to her just wanders around the hallway with her arms crossed, doing absolutely nothing.

You make an appointment with one nurse, and when you get there, another one sees you.

You can hear arguments going on inside the office while you wait.

I'm going to try to change my primary care center tomorrow because, my god.

one_star_reviews.text:
My father passed away on October 1st, and at such a painful and delicate time for our family, we expected to receive compassionate, supportive, and professional care.

Unfortunately, the initial assistance we received was extremely disappointing. The person who attended to us, who explained that she was covering a shift and would be returning to her job in another town the following day, treated us terribly. She was in a great hurry to finish and leave, leaving several crucial matters unresolved.

However, the next day we were fortunate enough to find Anna. She completely transformed our experience. She handled everything with immense professionalism, efficiency, and kindness. She was resourceful, attentive, and, above all, provided a compassionate approach that we greatly appreciated during such a difficult time.

We want to especially highlight Anna's professionalism, her willingness to help us, and the peace of mind she instilled in us by taking charge and resolving any outstanding issues. People like her truly make a difference in such a sensitive service.

Our sincere thanks to Anna for her excellent service and, at the same time, we hope that the management of the funeral home will take into account our experience with the first service received, because in moments like this, human touch and empathy are as important as the management itself.

Terrible treatment, little empathy at such a delicate moment, and even worse service.
Many mistakes. One star for Truyols and zero for Ana Chillida, the person I had the misfortune of being served by.

one_star_reviews.text:
Flyby, the school of deception...

In the beginning, things appeared to be okay.
The 1st phase of flying, which ends with the 1st solo, took me 2 months, which is very good for the weather in Burgos.
Things were fine to this point. After the 1st solo, the number of flights scheduled started reducing. Many weeks went without any.
By the time I started the 3rd phase, which is mostly X-country flights, I had 8 external exams done.
However, I only got 2 flights a month. Then, it reduced to 1 flight a month, then to 1 or 2 every 2 months.
At some point, I was only scheduled on days when the weather was bad. And once, when the weather forecast changed at night, I was surprised that my flight was cancelled when I reported at the airport the next day, when the sky was clear. I asked why the flight was cancelled, and the operations officer denied I had a flight!
When I did my last external exams, I did not pass the last exam. Then, I had to repeat most in 10 months and to attend 20% of ground school.
As soon as I started doing the internal exams, which were required to register for the externals, games were being played.
I once asked for the exact timings for the internal exams, only to go to the exam room on the allocated days to see that the time was not respected and that they shortened the time.
On those days, one TKI said that he needed to go home, but then he stayed in the airport for at least 2 hours.
Another day, a TKI said there would be external exams in the room, but there were none on those days!
One day, I attended the class, and all students were asked to do a particular exam, which I had already made internally and externally. I asked to do another one to apply for the externals next month, but I got no response. The TKI was in contact with the CTKI, and he did not respond to my email.
The CTKI (former) surprisingly wanted me to affirm that he had given me 'many' chances to do the exams, which were zero in reality.
Up to this point, I had lost 2 months from the 10 months, one from the ignored request, and another because of a technical problem with submitting the application for externals. This issue was explained, and yet, I got no response.
Then, I applied for my second sitting, and I was surprised that I was not scheduled, and no reason was given for that. Emails sent, and no responses. I had to go to ask for the reason, and their new game got exposed. The CTKI (former) had reserved a way to play around with my application. I had renewed my passport, and there was a slight change in my surname. It was shortened to only have the first letter. For the past sittings, the CTKI had asked me to put the entire surname. Every time I applied for the external exams, I did what he asked for, and I was allowed to do the exams.
When I applied for my 2nd sitting in the retake, I was told that I had to write the short surname. Now, you can see that the CTKI had done this to be able to cancel my application whenever he wishes, then to claim that the surname was written wrongly, when he had asked to write it differently.
Also, the external exams scheduled for the 10th month were removed.
In total, 4 months were lost from 10. I ended up having 6 exams at the end of the 9th month.
On several occasions in that period, the CTKI (former) and other staff were disrespectful and provocative, but none of those attempts to cause trouble worked.
At the end of the 10th month, I was surprised with a strange contract. They asked to repeat all exams, 100% of ground school, and pay €21k. I asked to continue doing the exams for 4-5 months, but I got no response for a month. Then, they offered a contract with the same fee but to finish in 3.5 months, when 4.5 months were available when I made my request. This left me confused since there may be a risk, especially with that big fee. The safe side was to avoid this school after what they had done.
This school has recently designed tactics to fail many students and to make the most profit out of them!

one_star_reviews.text: I've read that there are clients who know and speak with their lawyer, but I have no information about them. I'm told to leave my house quickly because I have to go without any official notification.

I've been trying to negotiate this obscure debt for months. I still don't know how much it is or where it came from. They've drafted two letters for me, which I've had to send myself, even though I gave them power of attorney to represent me. And I've paid every month without any explanation, just a curt "we're continuing negotiations," as if it were a Middle East peace agreement! I have to terminate their services, and they're threatening to sue me—it's outrageous!

Through this letter, I wish to express my complete dissatisfaction and frustration with the services provided by this firm. After having disbursed an amount exceeding €8,000 (for which I retain all transfer receipts), the result has been nil, and the process has been unjustifiably delayed. The main reasons for my complaint are detailed below: Lack of genuine engagement with creditors: I was assured that they would contact the creditor entities to negotiate my situation, an action that was never carried out. Neglect of legal claims: During the period in which the firm handled my case, lawsuits were filed against me that were neither appealed nor answered by them, leaving me completely defenseless. Irregularities in accounting and customer service: I was systematically asked to pay for payments I had already made. Even after sending copies of bank transfers as proof, the firm ignored my communications and continued to maintain that there were internal debts. Lack of transparency in retainer payments: I had been paying a monthly fee of €150 as a retainer. Despite this, when it came time to go to court, I was required to independently find and pay a solicitor, without any explanation as to how the monthly payments were being used. Constant demands for money without progress: The firm's only consistent response was to request more capital (asking for additional payments of up to €1,000 under the promise of filing a lawsuit), while the proceedings remained completely stalled. Conclusion: Given the firm's total inaction, I was forced to terminate their services and hire another law firm. This new firm resolved my legal situation in less than six months and at a significantly lower cost. This proves that my case was perfectly viable and that the delay and damages caused were due solely and exclusively to the lack of professionalism of their staff.

one_star_reviews.text:
Hello everyone. I'm writing to report the appalling management, attempted overcharging, and deceptive business practices of the MG dealership's workshop service in Sant Boi de Llobregat (QUADIS British), hoping this will serve as a warning and help you know how to defend yourselves if something similar happens to you.

I took my car (which is 3 years old and no longer under warranty because the previous maintenance records weren't stamped) to the workshop because it had three simultaneous electrical faults: both front power windows were malfunctioning (and I couldn't control the rear windows from the driver's side switch either), the automatic folding of the mirrors when locking/unlocking the car wasn't working, and the parking assist system wasn't functioning. Before I left it, something crucial happened: suddenly everything started working again on its own, except for the driver's side window. When I disconnected the battery to see if it would reset, everything malfunctioned again at once. When I dropped the car off at the garage, I explained the situation in detail, warning them that the fault stemmed from a common cause (a comfort module, control unit, or a power drop), practically giving them a diagnosis.

From then on, the garage receptionist, Julio, completely disregarded the bill, focusing on inflating it at all costs, taking advantage of the fact that I was paying for the repairs myself: Attempted maintenance scam: Seeing that the car was three years old and the service history wasn't stamped, Julio suggested I have the year three and year four services done together, giving me a quote of over €1,000. This was a blatant attempt at fraud, since both services overlapped by the exact same tasks (oil changes, spark plugs, filters, etc.). They were trying to charge me twice for parts and labor that would only be physically performed once.

Excessive and duplicate diagnostic charges: Upon checking MG's online tracking platform, I saw they intended to bill me €375.11 for diagnostics (€250 for the power window system and €125.11 for the parking sensors). This breakdown is unacceptable, as the computer reading of fault codes is performed by connecting the diagnostic tool to the OBD port only once to extract all codes simultaneously.
Fortunately, on their own website, the diagnostic charges appeared as "Pending Authorization," implicitly acknowledging that I had not previously approved any fee in writing (a mandatory requirement under Royal Decree 1457/1986). Furthermore, Julio himself had confirmed to me in writing that they hadn't even connected the diagnostic tool or performed any physical work.

Seeing that they had no legal basis for charging for the diagnostic, that I rejected the absurd €1,000 double service, and that I was fully aware of my consumer rights, they finally had to completely back down and returned my car to me free of charge.
Be very careful with this garage in Sant Boi and the maintenance "suggestions" from their staff. Being out of warranty doesn't give them the right to disregard consumer laws or charge for duplicate services or overlapping checks. Don't be intimidated: always check the status of your order on their website.

one_star_reviews.text: Their courier partner lost my item. Their customer services have not been responsive at all. I have asked for a refund but weeks later still awaiting a response. Have tried through email, chat and telephone to resolve. I would not recommend this company.

The service was appalling. I decided to buy from Kave Home because they were supposed to be reputable, a Spanish brand that sells "quality" and is well-known. Nothing could be further from the truth. I bought a dining table (not to replace one, but because I moved and literally don't have a table) on July 12, 2026. It's October 1st and I still haven't received it. In August, I called customer service. I spent two days calling without success. The next day I called again and after several attempts, they finally answered. I asked about the table and the woman told me that yes, they had had a problem and that the table would take a while to arrive. They haven't offered me any solution other than to wait, and here I am. Not a discount, not a solution that will compensate for the situation. I still don't have a table in my house, I'm €306 poorer, and I'm at the mercy of them showing up whenever they feel like it. I hope they deliver the table and that it's in perfect condition, but even so, I wouldn't recommend anyone buy from Kave Home. They're unreliable and couldn't care less whether your order arrives within a reasonable timeframe or not. If the table doesn't arrive this month, I'm going straight to the consumer protection office. What they're doing is outrageous, and from what I've just read in other reviews, most users have had the same experience.

They're quite expensive and offer zero service. I made an online purchase of an artificial plant, and they sent me an email confirming that the product had left the warehouse and would arrive between September 18th and 28th. The product never arrived, and they haven't told me where it is or when it will arrive.

Avoid this company for the sake of your mental health and your time.
I ordered two lamps. One of them arrived damaged, so I returned it, but it took them one month just to arrange the return with the courier. After that, I waited another month for the refund.
After two months in total, I asked for an update, and they told me to confirm that the return had been completed! Apparently, they have no idea where the product is or what happened to it.
Terrible customer service. Never again will I buy anything from this company.

OUTRAGEOUS.
We ordered 11 items, and most of them haven't arrived. Others are defective or incomplete, leaving us without a bed to sleep on.
I've called Customer Service several times, even requesting a callback by pressing the asterisk, but there's been no way to get through all week. "Scoundrels" doesn't even begin to cover it. We paid for everything in advance, and we haven't received anything complete. I eagerly await a response so I can file a formal complaint.

Very disappointing experience. I ordered a sofa in May and was told the delivery time would be around 6 weeks. It’s now September 23rd and I still haven’t received it. The delivery date has been postponed several times. I deeply regret buying from Kave Home and would not recommend them.

I'm writing this review after an unacceptable series of errors and a complete lack of professionalism on the part of Kave Home.

We bought a divan bed that took almost two months longer than expected to arrive. During this entire waiting period, communication was nonexistent: not a single explanation, not even a notification of an updated delivery date, nothing. Total uncertainty.

To make matters worse, the situation worsened on delivery day. The delivery workers brought the divan bed without the necessary screws, making assembly completely impossible. The solution they offered was appalling: we were literally left without a bed to sleep on and with a gigantic mess (the disassembled divan bed pieces) taking up all the space in the middle of the room.

Even the installers didn't know what to do or when the problem would be resolved, leaving us without a solution date or even an estimated timeframe. As if that weren't enough, trying to contact their customer service is an ordeal due to extremely limited phone hours, which makes any urgent matter difficult.

A disastrous experience from start to finish. They sell design and image, but the logistics, quality control, and after-sales service leave much to be desired. I don't recommend buying here if you need the furniture by a specific date or expect a responsible response to their own mistakes. As for the product quality, we'll see… but expectations are low.

I ended up accepting the euros option, but they still took another €10 from the refund in commissions.

Extremely misleading and clearly designed to make you lose as much of your refund as possible. Be very careful.

Never again with this company. I absolutely do not recommend it.

A complete disaster that shouldn't even exist anymore!

one_star_reviews.text:
My experience with Orange, and specifically with the store in El Cabañal on Calle Mediterráneo, has been unacceptable.

A few months ago, I went there in person because I needed a new line for an employee. Geraldi and Ana helped me. Before signing up for anything, I explicitly explained the problem I'd already had with Orange regarding contract terms that had never been properly explained to me. That's why I was very clear: I ONLY wanted to sign up for that line if it didn't have a contract term.

They assured me there wouldn't be a contract term. I signed up trusting what they were telling me in person.

Now, months later, when I went to cancel my Orange lines, I discovered that this line has a contract term until June 2027.

I went back to the store last week. At least they had the decency to admit it, that they were going to look into it internally, and told me they would call me the next day. No one called. I had to go back in person, and the final answer was that they can't do anything: either I keep the contract, pay the penalty, or suspend the line and continue paying.

The worst part is that this is NOT THE FIRST TIME Orange has done something like this to me.

Some time ago, I received a call from someone who identified themselves as an Orange agent and claimed to know all the details of my contract. They told me that, as a reward for my loyalty, they were going to give me some devices and also apply a discount.

I DID NOT SIGN ANYTHING related to those devices.

The devices arrived immediately. The discount never arrived. Months later, I discovered that those devices came with a 24-month contract and penalties of hundreds of euros per device. Furthermore, my bill, which was around €80, ended up reaching approximately €160.

From then on, months of calls to 1471 began. It was always the same: “It will be resolved in 24-48 hours,” “The case has been escalated,” “It’s urgent,” “We’ll call you.” No one ever called. One promise after another, and no solution.

Therefore, there are now TWO separate situations in which I was informed of certain conditions, and then Orange registered different ones.

First, devices with a contract I never signed.

Then, a phone line I contracted IN PERSON AT THIS STORE after specifically asking if it had a contract and receiving the answer NO, which now turns out to be until 2027.

Does a customer really have to distrust even what they are told in person at an Orange store?

Now I will formally demand all contracts, recordings, signatures, and receipts that Orange intends to use to prove that I accepted these contracts. And if they believe I accepted them, let them prove exactly WHERE, WHEN, AND HOW.

I will also file a formal complaint with the appropriate authorities.

After years as a customer, as soon as this situation is resolved, I will cancel all my Orange lines and will never contract anything with this company again.

And I don't need a generic response saying they "regret what happened" and that I should contact customer service again. I've already done that too many times.

I need something much simpler: for Orange to explain why I'm under contract with a minimum term that, according to the terms and conditions they communicated to me when I signed up, I never agreed to.
